description: Bassins hydrographiques fixant le cadre général des mesures sécheresse dans le département de l'Orne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. River basins, defined by the Prefectural Decree of the Orne, laying down the general framework for drought measures. This Order: signed 2 July 2012 and amended on 6 February 2018, sets thresholds (vigilance, alert, enhanced alert, crisis) based on: stream flows observed by measuring stations present on the main rivers of the department. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map visualisation service (WMS) of the dataset: River basins setting out the general framework for drought measures in t" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.1.1, WMS 1.3.0. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-10-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
